marking_points.text: unmodulated (radio) waves would interfere with each other or not modulating would require aerials too long (to be practical)
advantage: can transmit higher frequencies; higher quality reproduction; less prone to interference; same frequency can be used in different areas (any one point)
disadvantage: takes up greater bandwidth; shorter range of transmission; requires a greater number of transmitting aerials (any one point)
AM amplitude: min. 8 mV and max. 12 mV
AM frequency: min. 100 kHz and max. 100 kHz
FM amplitude: min. 10 mV and max. 10 mV
FM frequency: min. 90 kHz and max. 110 kHz
